Nyankopɔn nnwankuo so hwɛ
1 # 2 Yoh 1; Rom 8.17 Me a meyɛ ɔpanin bi ne Kristo amanehunu ho dansefoɔ ne animuonyam a wɔrebɛyi no adie no fafafoɔ nso, metu mpanimfoɔ a ɛwɔ mo mu no fo sɛ: 2#Yoh 21.16; Aso 20.28; 1 Ti 3.2-7 Monyɛne Nyankopɔn nnwankuo a wɔwɔ mo mu no. Monhwɛ wɔn so, ɛnyɛ ɔhyɛ so, na mmom ɔdɔ mu, sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ; ɛnyɛ adufudepɛ nti, na mmom akoma a ɛpɛ nti; 3#2 Ko 1.24; Tito 2.7 ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔdi asafotoɔ no so bakoma, na mmom monyɛ nhwɛsoɔ mma nnwankuo no. 4#1 Pe 2.25; Heb 13.20; 1 Ko 9.25; 2 Ti 4.8 Na odwanhwɛfoɔ panin no yi ne ho adi a, moanya animuonyam abotire a ɛrensɛe da no. 5#Efe 5.21; Mmb 3.34; Mat 23.12; Yak 4.6 Saa ara na mo mmabunu nso, momfa mo ho nhyɛ mpanimfoɔ aseɛ. Na mo nyinaa momfira ahobrɛaseɛ, na monsom mo ho mo ho, ɛfiri sɛ
Onyankopɔn si ahantanfoɔ kwan,
na ɔdom ahobrɛasefoɔ.
6 # Hiob 22.29; Yak 4.10 Enti mommrɛ mo ho ase Nyankopɔn tumi nsa no ase, na wama mo so, berɛ a ɛsɛ mu. 7#Dwom 55.22; Mat 6.25; Flp 4.6 Momfa mo dadwene ne haw nyinaa nto ne so, ɛfiri sɛ ɔdwene mo ho.
Monsi ɔsɔhwɛfoɔ no kwan
8 # 1 Te 5.6 Mo ani nna hɔ, monwɛn, ɛfiri sɛ mo tamfo bonsam no nam sɛ gyata a ɔbobom hwehwɛ deɛ ɔbɛnya no amene. 9#Efe 6.11-13 Ɔno na momfa gyidie nnyina hɔ pintinn nsi no kwan, ɛfiri sɛ monim sɛ amanehunu no ara na wɔde ato mo nuanom a wɔwɔ wiase soɔ sɛ wɔnhunu.
10 # 1 Pe 1.6 Na adom nyinaa Nyankopɔn a wafrɛ mo aba ne daa animuonyam no mu Kristo mu no, ɔno ara na sɛ monya hunu amane kakra ansa a, ɔbɛsiesie mo pɛ, ɔbɛma mo ase atim, ɔbɛhyɛ mo den, ɔbɛma moanya nnyinasoɔ. 11Ɔno na tumi wɔ no daa daa. Amen.
Nkradie ne nkyea
12 # Heb 13.22 Menam onua nokwafoɔ Silwano so, sɛdeɛ mebu no no, matwerɛ nsɛm tiawa yi mabrɛ mo, mede metu mo fo, na medi adanseɛ sɛ, yei ne Nyankopɔn nokorɛ adom a moabɛgyina mu yi. 13#Aso 12.12; 12.25; 2 Ti 4.11 Asafo a ɛwɔ Babel a wɔayi wɔn sɛ mo no, ne me ba Marko kyea mo. 14#1 Ko 16.20 Momfa ɔdɔ mfeano nkyeakyea mo ho mo ho. Asomdwoeɛ nka mo a mowɔ Kristo mu nyinaa.

pageProps.chapterText:
Me a meyɛ ɔpanin bi ne Kristo amanehunu ho dansefoɔ ne animuonyam a wɔrebɛyi no adie no fafafoɔ nso, metu mpanimfoɔ a ɛwɔ mo mu no fo sɛ: Monyɛne Nyankopɔn nnwankuo a wɔwɔ mo mu no. Monhwɛ wɔn so, ɛnyɛ ɔhyɛ so, na mmom ɔdɔ mu, sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ; ɛnyɛ adufudepɛ nti, na mmom akoma a ɛpɛ nti; ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔdi asafotoɔ no so bakoma, na mmom monyɛ nhwɛsoɔ mma nnwankuo no. Na odwanhwɛfoɔ panin no yi ne ho adi a, moanya animuonyam abotire a ɛrensɛe da no. Saa ara na mo mmabunu nso, momfa mo ho nhyɛ mpanimfoɔ aseɛ. Na mo nyinaa momfira ahobrɛaseɛ, na monsom mo ho mo ho, ɛfiri sɛ
Onyankopɔn si ahantanfoɔ kwan,
na ɔdom ahobrɛasefoɔ.
Enti mommrɛ mo ho ase Nyankopɔn tumi nsa no ase, na wama mo so, berɛ a ɛsɛ mu. Momfa mo dadwene ne haw nyinaa nto ne so, ɛfiri sɛ ɔdwene mo ho.

Mo ani nna hɔ, monwɛn, ɛfiri sɛ mo tamfo bonsam no nam sɛ gyata a ɔbobom hwehwɛ deɛ ɔbɛnya no amene. Ɔno na momfa gyidie nnyina hɔ pintinn nsi no kwan, ɛfiri sɛ monim sɛ amanehunu no ara na wɔde ato mo nuanom a wɔwɔ wiase soɔ sɛ wɔnhunu.
Na adom nyinaa Nyankopɔn a wafrɛ mo aba ne daa animuonyam no mu Kristo mu no, ɔno ara na sɛ monya hunu amane kakra ansa a, ɔbɛsiesie mo pɛ, ɔbɛma mo ase atim, ɔbɛhyɛ mo den, ɔbɛma moanya nnyinasoɔ. Ɔno na tumi wɔ no daa daa. Amen.

Menam onua nokwafoɔ Silwano so, sɛdeɛ mebu no no, matwerɛ nsɛm tiawa yi mabrɛ mo, mede metu mo fo, na medi adanseɛ sɛ, yei ne Nyankopɔn nokorɛ adom a moabɛgyina mu yi. Asafo a ɛwɔ Babel a wɔayi wɔn sɛ mo no, ne me ba Marko kyea mo. Momfa ɔdɔ mfeano nkyeakyea mo ho mo ho. Asomdwoeɛ nka mo a mowɔ Kristo mu nyinaa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
